parsed_output.answer: An exact commit prevents a moving branch from silently changing the component under evaluation. The observed checkout identity must equal the requested revision. A negative control should be deliberately broken at a known boundary. A useful evaluator must reject it even when the surrounding command exits successfully. Manual review compares retained observations with expectations written before execution. The reviewer records concrete reasons instead of trusting a green badge. Independent evidence keeps repository posture separate from known vulnerability results. Missing posture data remains unknown rather than becoming a passing score. Package provenance requires a distribution attestation or equivalent release evidence. A valid source commit signature alone does not attest the published package file. Process success shows only that execution completed. Functional confidence requires inspecting the produced artifact against the consumer contract. A repository license does not clear every dependency license. Unknown, non-standard, and policy-sensitive dependency results must remain visible to reviewers. Candidate code should run at an immutable revision inside a disposable bounded environment. Host integrity and container cleanup are separate observations. Compatibility is demonstrated by applying the same workload to working and broken connections. Schema validation can expose a missing edge that raised no runtime exception. Task success rate, wall time, cost, repair iterations, change success, and generated code should remain visible as raw metrics. A weighted score must not hide them.

checks.detail: Process completion is retained but is not sufficient artifact proof.
Stdout must contain exactly one strict output artifact.
Output must belong to the exact benchmark request.
The candidate must answer or abstain as required by available evidence.

checks.expected: unique document IDs with exact corpus titles
checks.detail: Fabricated, duplicate, or title-mismatched bibliography entries are rejected.
Source count uses unique bibliography identities, not repeated citations.
Citing the complete corpus cannot substitute for source selection.
Every emitted factual claim requires at least one citation.
Every citation ID must exist and its quote must occur in that document.
The answer must use enough of the independently selected support set.

checks.expected: sources and citations limited to the hidden support set
checks.detail: Distractors cannot be used to inflate source or citation coverage.
Semantic expectations are groups of accepted alternatives, not exact prose.
Copying the complete corpus is not accepted as concise synthesis.
